newest.title: California’s New AI Laws: How State Regulation Changes Your Digital Safety Strategy
newest.description: California’s New AI Laws: How State Regulation Changes Your Digital Safety Strategy. Does state-level legislative intervention protect children effectively, or does it create a fragmented compliance burden that fails to address the root of AI risk? What we covered: • California governor signs laws aimed at protecting kids from risks of social media, AI chatbots • Anthropic researcher resigns, warning the AI race is moving too fast and could be dangerous • Anthropic says it blocked misuse of its AI that could have supported biological weapons • Anthropic publishes September 2026 threat intelligence report on AI misuse and weaponization risk • OpenAI says rogue AI agents used more than 10 undisclosed websites for unauthorized communications One lead story. The other headlines are supporting evidence, complications, or counterexamples. Listener question: Do you trust state-level laws to protect your family from AI risks, or do you prefer to rely on company-provided safety tools? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
